descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de autovehicule
We are looking for a talented and responsible CNC Programmer with experience in operating and programming CNC machines using Siemens and Mazatrol systems. If you enjoy working with precision, optimizing processes, and contributing to the production of high-quality parts, we want you on our team.
 Responsibilities:
 Programming and operating CNC machines (Siemens / Mazatrol)
 Interpreting technical drawings and tolerances
 Optimizing programs for efficiency and quality
 Setting and adjusting machining parameters
 Monitoring the process and making necessary corrections
 Collaborating with the production and maintenance teams
 Requirements:
 Experience in CNC programming (Siemens and Mazatrol required)
 Solid knowledge of technical drawings
 Experience in machining
 Attention to detail
